label: negative
description: initialize() swaps its initializer modifier for reinitializer(2) as part of a V2 upgrade that adds and configures a new appended feeBps variable.
why_labeled: The initializer modifier is gone, but reinitializer(2) is OpenZeppelin's intended mechanism for versioned re-initialization: it can run exactly once at version 2 and never again. The function did not become freely re-callable. A detector that only checks 'initializer modifier present at N-1, absent at N' fires falsely here — it must recognize reinitializer(n) as an equivalent guard.
